measurement.input: PDF pixels; HWPX reference; no reference or PDF text fed to engines/selector
measurement.execution: unchanged source Python 0.11.0 actual application APIs; sequential CPU workers
measurement.profiles: preselected from source language; language/direction autodetection not evaluated
measurement.metric: whitespace-only Unicode codepoint Levenshtein CER, including reading order/punctuation/variants; weighted by reference characters
measurement.secondary_metric: letters/numbers; canonical CJK compatibility ideographs only; no simplified/traditional folding
measurement.memory: 50ms sampled sum of controller+recursive child private bytes/RSS; RSS may double-count shared pages; not instantaneous peak
measurement.timing: single trial including renderer/model process startup; automatic includes candidate comparisons, selection, and save; filesystem cache uncontrolled
measurement.engine_support: v6 excludes mixed; v5 uses server detection+mobile recognition and Korean recognizer for mixed; EasyOCR uses Korean for mixed; mixed auto only Tesseract
measurement.blank: 초신접기 p5 correctly empty; excluded from CER denominator and selection audit; app no-text error retained separately
measurement.column_diagnostic: scorer-only coordinate reorder for 의방집해; not app accuracy or selected output
measurement.limits: printed horizontal PDFs; no claim for scans/vertical/camera or packaged GUI speed

environment.measurement: single trial, sequential CPU workers; 50ms process-tree samples; filesystem cache uncontrolled
environment.execution: source Python 0.11.0; unchanged real comparison and automatic application functions, not packaged GUI timing
